Two MirrorMaker processes replicate A->B, one with topics foo and the other with topics bar, and only one topic is replicated. Why?
reference_answer: MirrorMaker processes share configuration through the target cluster, so different configurations for the same target race. Depending on which process is the elected leader, only foo or only bar is replicated. Keep the configuration consistent across flows to the same target.

question: Why are my console-consumer test groups not replicated by MirrorMaker?
reference_answer: By default groups.exclude = console-consumer-.*, connect-.*, __.*, so groups created by kafka-console-consumer.sh are not replicated. Change groups.exclude for testing and change it back afterwards.
